title: Rapid HMW DNA Isolation from Plant Tissues Using CTAB
author: Miguel Flores
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcukiwuw

steps.title: Collect and snap‑freeze tissue
steps.instruction: Place plant tissue into a 50 mL Falcon tube and immediately snap‑freeze in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Grind tissue to fine powder
steps.instruction: Pour a small amount of liquid nitrogen into a mortar precooled to –70 °C, add the frozen sample, and grind, adding more liquid nitrogen as needed, until a fine powder is obtained.

steps.title: Transfer powder to tubes
steps.instruction: Using a spatula precooled in liquid nitrogen, transfer the powder into 2‑mL polypropylene microfuge tubes, then place the tubes back into liquid nitrogen to keep the material frozen.

steps.title: Preheat extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Heat the CTAB extraction buffer in a 65 °C water bath until the temperature is reached.

steps.title: Add buffer and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 1.2 mL of the pre‑heated extraction buffer to each tube containing frozen powder, invert for 5–10 s to mix, then incubate at 65 °C for 30 min, inverting the tubes every 5–10 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge to clear debris
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 13,500 g for 10 min at room temperature (RT); retain the supernatant for the next step.

steps.title: Prepare PLG tubes with organic solvent
steps.instruction: Dispense 800 µL of phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol into each 2‑mL Phase Lock Gel (PLG Heavy) tube (one tube per sample).

steps.title: Phase‑lock extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant from step 6 into the PLG tubes prepared in step 7, close tightly, and gently invert for 20 min at 20–22 °C (a nutator may be used); then centrifuge at 13,500 g for 10 min at RT to separate phases.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous layer to a new 2‑mL microfuge tube containing 800 µL cold isopropanol (stored at –20 °C), invert to mix, and incubate at RT for 10 min to precipitate DNA; thereafter centrifuge at 13,500 g for 10 min at RT.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in TE
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant with a micropipette and gently resuspend the DNA pellet in 250 µL TE buffer at RT.

steps.title: RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 µL DNase‑free RNase A (10 mg/mL) to the suspension and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: NaAc/ethanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL of 3 M sodium acetate, pH 5, mix, then add 600 µL of precooled 100 % ethanol (–20 °C), mix, and incubate at –20 °C for 20 min to precipitate DNA; centrifuge at 13,500 g for 10 min at RT.

steps.title: 70 % ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Perform two consecutive 70 % ethanol washes to clean the DNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL cold (–20 °C) 70 % (v/v) ethanol, do not dislodge the pellet, centrifuge 13,500 g for 5 min at RT, and remove the supernatant.
Repeat: add another 500 µL cold 70 % ethanol, centrifuge 13,500 g for 5 min at RT, and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Remove residual ethanol and dry
steps.instruction: Discard any remaining supernatant, perform a quick spin to collect residual ethanol at the tube bottom, remove it with a P20 tip, then air‑dry the pellet for 5 min at RT without overdrying.

steps.title: Final resuspension and storage
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried DNA pellet in 100 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 8; incubate at 4 °C with gentle mixing overnight; store at 4 °C for up to one week or at –80 °C for long‑term storage.
